messages:
SARAH: Heads up — SamCorp flagged signing flow for a dual-entity reseller deal. PO requested net45, legal redlined MSA + DPA subproc wording. Also they asked about SSO + KMS. Need signer chain mapping. :thinking_face:

RAJ: @sarah can you attach the redlines? if it's the usual subproc we can accept with an EU addendum. which legal entity is counterparty?

SARAH: Counterparty: SamCorp US (parent) and SamCorp EU (sister). They want one PO that covers both, but two signers by region. They called it a "zipper" flow — both signatures must complete. Order form draft attached.

MARTA: Net45 ok from billing side but AR needs invoice entity and tax IDs. Also flag: pricing discount is tied to commitment tier; including EU will change tier thresholds.

LEO: SE note: SSO/KMS integration optional on Hosted. If they require HSM-backed KMS, that's enterprise add-on — recommend Dedicated + KMS. Proposal (informal):
```
1) PO submitted -> billing entity resolved
2) If EU entity included -> execute DPA addendum for EU
3) Both signers e-sign -> contract becomes effective
fallback: if EU signer delays >7d -> follow manual escalation
```

RAJ: Can't auto-fail to escrow. Legal needs explicit consent for alternate execution paths. Suggest change: "If countersign not completed within 30 days, parties may agree on alternate payment routing or execution mechanics." Customer must accept.

SARAH: @sam_corp can you confirm ok with 30-day clause and clarify which entity pays?

sam_corp: Sam (customer): 30 days is fine. Payments will be made by SamCorp US initially; EU entity wants entitlement on the PO. Can we have one PO referencing both entities?

MARTA: We can accept a single PO that references both entities but we require separate invoices and exact legal names + tax IDs. I'll create a billing matrix and invoice templates.

RAJ: I'll draft a DPA addendum scoped to the EU sister and update the signature matrix. @sarah add me to the countersign loop when ready.

esign-bot: e-sign request sent to sarah, sam, eu_signer. Link: https://redwood.esign/req/0xdef456 :white_check_mark:

SARAH: Action items:
- @RAJ: draft addendum (EOD Wed)
- @MARTA: billing matrix + invoice template
- @LEO: update SE/KMS upsell note
- @sam_corp: confirm PO text

sam_corp: Will send PO tomorrow morning. Thanks! :thumbsup:
